decision_authority: Owner decision 1 (Phase 9 brief): RETAIN the 14 Phase 8 CFB/CBB inputs and their verification evidence; they stay RIGHTS_UNRESOLVED / INTERNAL_RESEARCH_ONLY. No new collection and no redistribution from unresolved sportsdataverse-derived sources. A repository CODE licence is never treated as licensing upstream data.

tier_meaning.UNRESOLVED_INTERNAL_ONLY: no data licence read from an authoritative source; internal research only; not cleared for redistribution or commercial use
tier_meaning.WRAPPER_LICENCE_UPSTREAM_CAVEAT: a licence on the aggregator's data repository was read, but upstream source terms were not separately granted; counted as NOT rights-cleared in the strict measure
tier_meaning.CLEARED_NONCOMMERCIAL_RESEARCH: the data author's licence was read verbatim and permits this research use (non-commercial, attribution, share-alike obligations apply)
tier_meaning.CLEARED_OPEN_LICENCE: open data licence (CC0) read verbatim from the data repository

phase10_decision: Owner decision 2 (Phase 10 brief): nflverse stays WRAPPER_ONLY (tier WRAPPER_LICENCE_UPSTREAM_CAVEAT), NOT fully rights-cleared, until the relevant upstream NFL/FTN/NGS/ESPN rights have been evaluated; its computational evidence is retained. Non-commercial research clearance and commercial-use clearance are now tracked as two separate flags.

clearance_semantics.research_cleared: tier in rights_cleared_tiers: an explicit data licence read verbatim permits internal non-commercial research use
clearance_semantics.commercial_cleared: tier in commercial_cleared_tiers: an explicit licence read verbatim permits commercial use (CC0 only). CC BY-NC-SA is research-only and is NEVER commercial-cleared; a wrapper-only licence is neither
clearance_semantics.note: RESEARCH_ONLY posture: nothing here authorises commercial use; commercial availability is reported only to size the rights question
